headline: Anderson draw level with Catawba at the top
dek: Anderson beat Carson-Newman at home on Saturday and sit level with Catawba at the top, after Catawba were held goalless by Emory & Henry the same day. Anderson, like Catawba, are unbeaten, with five wins and two draws. Lincoln Memorial, perfect in conference play until the weekend, lost at Newberry.
displaced_by: Catawba and Lincoln Memorial both dropped their first conference points on Saturday, so the standing dek is no longer true; Anderson's win over Carson-Newman puts them level with Catawba.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Catawba have scored twenty-two and conceded three, and no one player has more than Alex Payton's four of those goals.

wire.line: Emory & Henry have two published results, both draws, and both against the conference's unbeaten sides.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches whose dates have passed carry no result: Newberry's opener at Converse, and the rest all Emory & Henry's, the latest of them at home to Palm Beach Atlantic.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Newberry have won their last two after five defeats, and have scored nine and conceded sixteen.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lincoln Memorial have scored eleven and conceded seven in three wins, a draw and two defeats; the latest defeat came at Newberry on Saturday.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lenoir-Rhyne are still without a win: two draws and four defeats, eight scored and sixteen conceded, the latest defeat at Lincoln Memorial on Wednesday.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lincoln Memorial's Daniel Benedek Miklosi has made twenty-eight saves and conceded seven goals.

last_match.line: Anderson remain unbeaten; Carson-Newman have now lost as many as they have won.

next_match.line: Lenoir-Rhyne are still without a win; Wingate lost their only conference match so far.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
